reason: The tester README in the installer zip is generated from code by build_readme.py. Editing commands, install steps or the module list breaks or silently changes it, and nothing currently tells a future editor this. Born as the class of build-output README work, with the BASE-060 case as its first instance.

The README generator had three rules the skill lacked: the installer carries the onboarding chain, the Node version has one source, and Claude Code is connected only through .mcp.json. The episode changed all three and the README had to be checked against them.
